annotations.title: Digital Product Passport (DPP) & ESPR Payload Validator

description:
[Deterministic ESPR & DPP validation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits Digital Product Passport (DPP) payloads under EU ESPR Regulation 2024/1781, validates GS1 Digital Link URIs, verifies REACH Art. 33 Candidate List SVHC thresholds (>0.1% w/w), and scores circularity & repairability index.
Usage: Use this tool to validate product passport schemas for batteries, textiles, electronics, and construction products before EU market entry.
Returns: JSON object with { isValidDpp: boolean, digitalLinkValidation: object, svhcCompliance: object, circularityMetrics: object, carbonMetrics: object, esprComplianceStatus: string }.

productCategory.description: Target product sector under ESPR / Battery Regulation
